title: clitoria ternatea f. albiflora
intro: Clitoria ternatea f. albiflora, commonly known as the blue butterfly pea or white flowered blue pea, is a variety of the Clitoria ternatea plant, which is a flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress, improving memory, and promoting antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Clitoria ternatea f. albiflora are believed to be due to its ability to modulate neurotransmitters, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, and other compounds that contribute to its potential health benefits.
